title: Use sticker for commercial?
description:
Hi team 👋

I’m currently working on a book project related to R and machine Learning, and I’d love to include some of your hex sticker designs on the cover. Specifically for `tidyverse`, `tidymodels`, `pins`, `vetiver`, and `plumber`. Or may be other stickers that related and I needed in the future.

Thanks in advance for your guidance, and thank you for all the amazing work you do for the R community 🙌

title: rendering README in GHA on PR when comes from a fork does not work
description:
We encountered this here https://github.com/rstudio/hex-stickers/pull/60 and https://github.com/rstudio/hex-stickers/pull/61. (logs are probably not there anymore). 

In both cases, it came from a fork. The issue is related to the use of `r-lib/actions/pr-push` 
https://github.com/rstudio/hex-stickers/blob/93361e262a3dcdc3913777d9fc36cb503d231a2d/.github/workflows/render-readme.yaml#L31-L33
which doesn't have the correct access right because Github token passed is read-only on fork when trigger on pull request (which is different from comment). 

More on GITHUB_TOKEN permission: https://docs.github.com/en/actions/security-guides/automatic-token-authentication#permissions-for-the-github_token

`pr-push` action was made for comment triggered action in the first place, and write access is there. 

We need a two way process to render the README on PR from fork I guess.

title: Move `master` branch to `main`
description:
Cc @hadley

The `master` branch of this repository will soon be renamed to `main`, as part of a coordinated change across several GitHub organizations (including, but not limited to: [tidyverse](https://github.com/tidyverse), [r-lib](https://github.com/r-lib), [tidymodels](https://github.com/tidymodels), and [sol-eng](https://github.com/sol-eng)). We anticipate this will happen by the end of September 2021.

That will be preceded by a release of the [usethis package](https://usethis.r-lib.org), which will gain some functionality around detecting and adapting to a renamed default branch. There will also be a blog post at the time of this `master` --> `main` change.

The purpose of this issue is to:

* Help us firm up the list of targetted repositories
* Make sure all maintainers are aware of what's coming
* Give us an issue to close when the job is done
* Give us a place to put advice for collaborators re: how to adapt

*message id: entire_lizard*

title: Hex size requirements are not perfect hexagons
description:
From https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hexagon#Parameters

* `d` is the short diameter
* `D` is the maximal diameter

``` r
D <- 2557
(d = sqrt(3) / 2 * D)
#> [1] 2214.427
```

<sup>Created on 2020-08-19 by the [reprex package](https://reprex.tidyverse.org) (v0.3.0)</sup>

This does not equal `2206px`. 

Reversing the formula

``` r
d <- 2206
(D = 2 / sqrt(3) * d)
#> [1] 2547.269
```

<sup>Created on 2020-08-19 by the [reprex package](https://reprex.tidyverse.org) (v0.3.0)</sup>

This does not equal `2557px`. 

-----------------------

I'd like to get the `plumber` hex added in https://github.com/rstudio/hex-stickers/pull/29 but want to be sure that I'm required to squish/stretch the image from a perfect hexagon.

cc @allisonhorst
